activity_summary: At night the letter was still in the room. You had not written them the pump. You kept Thursday as the day it goes, and you stopped before the children became a speech.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stopped, and did not add a speech about the children.

entities.name: the Candlemas letter
entities.context: Mentioned in The pump at home

facets.activity: Left the packet on the desk

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The paper knows it, and the paper is still in this room.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: If I say more than that I shall make a speech of them.
